desc: How many islands does Indonesia have? More than seventeen thousand, spread wider than the United States. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: One country, thousands of islands! 🌴 Could you visit them all? Comment YES or NO. Follow for a fact every day. Send this to a friend.

lines.text: How many islands does Indonesia have? More than seventeen thousand.
Stretched across a map, it is wider than the United States.
It sits on the equator, between two great oceans.
Big islands include Sumatra, Java and Sulawesi.
More than seventeen thousand islands, one country. Could you visit them all?
